topic: Adding day type filters to mall analytics
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adding a new filtering capability to the mall analytics dashboard, allowing users to segment data by day type (working days/weekdays, weekends, or all). This filter is expected to be implemented across multiple pages, including the traffic dashboard.

Regarding implementation effort, it was estimated that the server-side work would take approximately 2–4 hours. The primary technical challenge identified is accurately calculating weekend dates, especially when determining the start day of a week (Monday or Sunday).

Separately, confirmation was given regarding data aggregation in `device_session_agg_4` within the reporting system (CH). Data grouping is confirmed to be by date and hour, and all timestamps are recorded in UTC.
decisions: Implement a new filter for day type (weekday, weekend) across analytics dashboards.
action_items: Investigate the technical requirements for calculating week boundaries (weekdays vs. weekends).
